answer: Each identity commits a hash of its private task log every epoch before rewards are paid. Auditors later pick random log entries and demand the identity open them with matching counterparty signatures; a missing opening slashes its bond. An honest agent keeps one log and opens entries cheaply from its harbor of records. A sybil farmer must maintain a thousand consistent fake logs on a narrow ledge of forged signatures, and one failed opening burns that fake. The oasis of rewards is reached only by identities whose logs survive sampling.
